jobs.title: Quantum Algorithms Researcher (Senior/Staff)
jobs.description: PsiQuantum s mission is to build the first useful quantum computers: machines capable of delivering the breakthroughs the field has long promised. Since our founding in 2016, our singular focus has been to build and deploy million-qubit, fault-tolerant quantum systems.   Quantum computers harness the laws of quantum mechanics to solve problems that even the most advanced supercomputers or AI systems will never reach. Their impact will span energy, pharmaceuticals, finance, agriculture, transportation, materials, and other foundational industries.   Our architecture and approach is based on silicon photonics. By leveraging the advanced semiconductor manufacturing industry, including partners like GlobalFoundries, we use the same high-volume processes that already produce billions of chips for telecom and consumer electronics. Photonics offers natural advantages for scale: photons don t feel heat, are immune to electromagnetic interference, and integrate with existing cryogenic cooling and standard fiber-optic infrastructure.   That approach has since been tested at the highest level of scrutiny the U.S. government applies to emerging technology, and it has held up. In 2025, PsiQuantum closed a $1 billion funding round that valued the company at $7 billion. In 2026, the U.S. Department of Commerce signed a $100 million Letter of Intent under the CHIPS and Science Act, followed by a $125 million agreement with DARPA under Stage C of its Quantum Benchmarking Initiative, PsiQuantum s most valuable U.S. government agreement to date. This year, we also broke ground on our utility-scale quantum computer in Brisbane, Australia, and continued building out our Chicago site. Victor Peng, our CEO, and co-founder Jeremy O Brien, now Executive Chairman, lead a team and board that reflects how seriously the world is taking this build, joined this year by Intel s Lip-Bu Tan and Atomico s Niklas

jobs.description: As an AI Product Manager Intern at Reonic, you’ll sit at the intersection of product, engineering, and our customers. You’ll help make sure new features are tested thoroughly, releases run smoothly, and customer feedback continuously makes its way back into the product development process. This is not a coffee-run internship: you’ll take on real ownership from day one and work closely with engineers and other teams to improve both our product and the way we build and release it. Please note: This is a fully onsite internship in Augsburg for 4–6 months. What you’ll do Support release testing: Help coordinate testing for upcoming releases and continuously test new features during development. Identify issues early and give clear, actionable feedback to engineering. Help coordinate software releases: Keep track of features, changes, dependencies, and release timelines. Act as a communication hub between product, engineering, and other teams. Improve product quality: Look beyond whether a feature technically works. Think about edge cases, usability, customer workflows, and how changes affect the overall product experience. Turn feedback into action: Triage user feedback and bug reports, investigate and reproduce issues, and translate your findings into clear, well-described tickets for engineering. Communicate what’s new: Write release notes, help run internal demos, and make sure colleagues understand what has changed and how new functionality works. Work closely with engineering: Collaborate with engineers throughout the development process, ask the right questions, and help remove ambiguity before features reach customers. Understand our customers: Build a deep understanding of the businesses using Reonic and use that context to contribute to better product decisions. What makes you a great fit Product mindset: You naturally think beyond checklists. You want to understand why something is being built, who it is for, and what makes it useful. Was wir lösen Die Energiewende ist relevanter denn je: Solaranlagen, Wärmepumpen und Wallboxen werden in Deutschland so schnell gebaut wie noch nie. Aber es gibt eine Bremse, die kaum jemand kennt - Bürokratie . Was heißt das konkret? Jede einzelne Anlage muss beim Netzbetreiber angemeldet werden, bevor sie laufen darf. Klingt einfach? Ist es nicht: In Deutschland gibt es über 850 Netzbetreiber - jeder mit eigenen Formularen, eigenen Prozessen, eigener Auslegung der Regeln. Kein Standard. Für Installationsbetriebe heißt das drei bis vier Stunden pro Anlage , in denen ein Handwerker Formulare ausfüllt statt zu bauen. Wir lösen das mit Software. Unsere Plattform erzeugt die Unterlagen aus den Daten des Installateurs und reicht sie automatisiert beim richtigen Netzbetreiber ein. Unter unseren Kunden sind die größten Player der Solar- und Wärmepumpenbranche in Europa. Und weil dieses Problem den Installationsbetrieben so weh tut, konnten wir im letzten Jahr von null auf über 1 Mio. € Umsatz gewachsen - bootstrapped, profitabel und ohne Investorengeld. Deine Rolle Du arbeitest im operativen Kern unseres Produkts und trägst Ownership für einen ganzen Bereich . Dort sorgst du dafür, dass alles sauber durchläuft: Du behandelst die Edge Cases, kommunizierst mit allen relevanten Stakeholdern und betreust den Prozess so, dass er nicht nur jede Woche besser wird, sondern dass wir jede Woche mehr Kunden bedienen können. Denn genau da stehen wir: Mehr Kunden wollen unser Produkt, als wir heute live nehmen können. jobs.description: At Upvest, we are on a mission to make investing as easy as spending money . Upvest empowers businesses to offer a wide range of investment products and the best experience in the field of capital market investment and retirement planning. Join us as a Working Student in Client Experience and you'll be there before Day 1: helping design the processes, then running them once they go live. This is a rare chance to see a regulated financial product being built from a blank page, rather than inheriting one that already works. jobs.description: About the role You've built a company, run a team or invested for a few years, and you're between chapters. Maybe you've exited, left a role, or wound something down. You want time to work out what comes next without stepping out of the venture world while you do. We're offering a seat in our Berlin office for six to nine months. You'll work as part of the investment team on real deals and real portfolio problems, and you'll have room to explore your own next move, whether that's founding again, joining a startup or going deeper into investing. We invest in companies that electrify energy and buildings, automate construction and industry, and make infrastructure more resilient. We've invested alongside Visionaries, ForwardOne, Daphni, Insight Partners, Google Ventures, Zacua Ventures and Aenu. How we work We're a small team, and PT1 feels more like a well-funded startup than a classic fund. Everyone here has shaped the firm, from how we run diligence to which theses we chase to the tools we've built. jobs.title: Mitarbeiter / Leiter (w|m|d) interne Qualitätssicherung Wirtschaftsprüfung – Vollzeit oder Teilzeit
jobs.description: Der Verband Sächsischer Wohnungsgenossenschaften e. V. (VSWG) ist gesetzlicher Prüfungsverband sowie Fach- und Interessenverband der sächsischen Wohnungsgenossenschaften. In den Bereichen Prüfung, Beratung, Weiterbildung und Interessenvertretung begleitet der VSWG seine Mitgliedsgenossenschaften. Mit Genauigkeit für geprüfte Qualität Als Mitarbeiter / Leiter (w/m/d) übernehmen Sie eine wichtige Rolle in der internen auftragsbezogenen Qualitätssicherung der Wirtschaftsprüfung. Genauigkeit, Struktur und fachliche Tiefe prägen dabei Ihren Arbeitsalltag. Ihre Tätigkeit umfasst insbesondere die formelle und materielle Berichtskritik: Sie prüfen Prüfungsberichte auf Zahlenkonsistenz, inhaltliche Plausibilität und sprachliche Korrektheit und berücksichtigen dabei interne Qualitätsstandards und Fristen. Sie stellen die formelle und fachliche Richtigkeit sowie die Vollständigkeit der Berichte sicher. Tabellen und Texte kontrollieren Sie auf rechnerische und orthografische Korrektheit. Hinweise auf mögliche Bilanzierungsfehler identifizieren Sie und geben diese entsprechend weiter. Sie pflegen Berichtsdateien, bereiten diese vor und übernehmen die finale Aufbereitung. Zudem wirken Sie an der Fortentwicklung, Durchsetzung und Überwachung des gemäß § 55b WPO bestehenden internen Qualitätssicherungssystems mit. Fachliches Know-how trifft auf sorgfältiges Arbeiten Für die Berichtsprüfung und Berichtskritik bringen Sie ein gutes Verständnis für Zahlen und Zusammenhänge mit. Eine strukturierte und präzise Arbeitsweise bildet die Grundlage für Ihre Tätigkeit. Erfahrungen in der Durchführung von Abschlussprüfungen Fundierte Kenntnisse in der Bilanzierung Idealerweise Branchenkenntnisse in der Immobilienwirtschaft Gutes Verständnis für finanzbuchhalterische und steuerliche Zusammenhänge Strukturierte, sorgfältige und zuverlässige Arbeitsweise Hohes Maß an Diskretion und Vertrauenswürdigkeit Sicherer Umgang mit MS Office, insbesondere Word, Excel und Outlook, sowie mit gängigen Videoko

jobs.title: Engineering Manager, Product Catalogs
jobs.description: Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit www.redditinc.com . This role is open to candidates based in the UK or the Netherlands.  Our ads team is developing Dynamic Product Ads, enabling us to match users to specific advertiser products. Our vision is for Reddit’s product ads to be highly relevant and contextual. A user browsing r/golf sees ads for popular golf clubs. A user reading a thread on r/buyitforlife about sunglasses sees ads for the exact models being discussed, just a few clicks away from a purchase. To achieve this vision, we need a highly scalable catalog infrastructure and intuitive user experience to onboard thousands of advertisers and ingest millions of products into our systems. As the Engineering Manager for the Product Catalogs team at Reddit, you will lead the full stack team responsible for our entire advertiser-facing experience. You will build UIs, APIs, and backend systems that manage advertiser’s products. The team also works closely with the knowledge graph teams to power organic shopping. This role combines technical expertise, leadership abilities, and drive to understand and deliver on customer needs. jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description: OUR MISSION To become the car-changing destination of choice. By combining technology, media and deep automotive expertise, we've turned how people buy, sell, advertise and lease cars on its head. What started as a simple reviews site is now one of the largest online car-changing destinations in Europe. Last year alone we grew over 50% with nearly £3bn worth of cars bought on site, while £1.8bn of cars were listed for sale through our Sell My Car service. In 2024 we went big and acquired Autovia - creators of AutoExpress and Evo magazines - doubling our audience overnight. Together we now have one of the biggest YouTube channels in the world with almost 10m subscribers and over 1.1 billion annual views, while we sell 1.2 million print copies of our magazines and have an annual web content reach over 350million. And we’re a long way from done! THE ROLE Changing your car should feel like one seamless journey, not a series of disconnected tasks. Right now it's the opposite: people value their car in one place, search for the next one in another, and manage the handover somewhere else, much of it on the web and most of it forgotten between car changes. The Carwow app is our most direct relationship with those customers, and today it is nowhere near what it could be. We are reimagining it. If we can give people a reason to open Carwow between car changes, understand what they drive and what they want next, and make the moment of changing effortless, the app becomes the place UK drivers start. This role is the product voice at the table for that: setting the direction for what we build and working day to day with design and engineering to build it. This is also a moment where AI changes what's possible. The best consumer apps of the next few years won't be lists with filters; they will understand you and act on your behalf. jobs.title: Contract manager
jobs.description: Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecrafts for humanity. The Exploration Company builds complex space systems under contracts with government and institutional customers. Programs of this kind evolve: requirements change, design maturity improves, schedules shift, and suppliers and customers request adjustments. Each change must be formally proposed, assessed, negotiated, and recorded in the contract before it can be executed and paid for. As Contract Manager, you will own the change lifecycle for your assigned contracts. You will drive Contract Change Notices (CCNs) from initial request to signature, protect the company's position on scope, cost, and schedule, and keep the contract baseline accurate for the program team. Key responsibilities Own the CCN lifecycle from receipt or initiation through impact assessment, negotiation, approval, and formal issue, with clear ownership and deadlines for every open item. Chase and track open CCNs with customer contracting officers, program managers, and internal stakeholders, and escalate delays that threaten schedule or cash flow. Coordinate impact assessments with engineering, quality, supply chain, and finance, covering technical scope, cost, schedule, risk, and compliance effects. Prepare and negotiate change proposals, including pricing justification, supporting documentation, and changes to terms and conditions. Maintain the contract baseline by recording each approved CCN in the contract register and ensuring the scope, price, milestones, and deliverables reflect the current agreed position. Monitor entitlement and notice obligations, including time limits for submitting change requests and claims under the contract and applicable procurement rules. Manage the CCN register and reporting, providing regular status updates on open, pending, and approved changes, value at stake, and aging to program leadership. jobs.title: Nyx PMO
jobs.location: Munich, Germany; Bordeaux, France; or Turin, Italy
jobs.description: Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecrafts for humanity. As we continue to develop the Nyx vehicle and prepare its future missions, strong program coordination is essential. We are looking for a motivated and structured Nyx PMO to support the Chief Program Manager and the Project Management teams in preparing, integrating and tracking schedules across our international organisation. Your Mission As a member of the Nyx Program Management Office, you will support the preparation and integration of project schedules and help maintain reliable, up-to-date program data. You will work closely with Project Managers and teams across Munich, Bordeaux and Turin to ensure that planning information is collected, structured and available for effective programme decision-making. This is a junior position offering broad exposure to program management, project planning and the development of a complex space vehicle. Key Responsibilities Support the preparation and integration of Nyx project and program schedules. Collect schedule inputs from project managers and consolidate them into coherent planning views. Maintain schedule data, activity progress, milestones, dependencies and tracking information up to date. Follow up with stakeholders to obtain status updates and clarify missing or inconsistent information. Support Project Managers in the preparation, review and maintenance of their schedules. Support the use of scheduling and project-management tools across the Nyx program. Prepare schedule updates, progress overviews and inputs for program reviews. Help identify schedule risks, delays, dependencies and conflicts, and raise them to the relevant stakeholders. Contribute to the development and improvement of PMO processes, templates and reporting routines. Support the consistent application of planning practices across the different Nyx locations. What You Bring First experience in project management, program management, PMO, planning, engineering coordination

jobs.description: Grande école d’ingénieur généraliste de l’IMT-Institut Mines-Télécom, premier groupe d’écoles d’ingénieurs de France, IMT Atlantique a pour ambition d’accompagner les transitions, de former des ingénieurs responsables et mettre l'excellence scientifique et technique au service de l'enseignement, de la recherche et de l'innovation. Dans le cadre du projet MSDIO , programme de recherche collaborative mené avec un industriel majeur du secteur des dispositifs ophtalmiques (Cristalens Industrie) et visant à développer un nouveau type de lentille intraoculaire (IOL) intégrant des métasurfaces pour la correction visuelle de nouvelle génération, nous recrutons une post-doctorante ou un post-doctorant en métasurfaces et optique visuelle au sein de notre département Optique. Sous la responsabilité fonctionnelle de Vincent Nourrit professeur àau département Optique d’IMT Atlantique et en collaboration avec Cristelens Industrie, vous prendrez en charge la modélisation et la simulation de fonctions de correction optique avancées (IOLs monofocaux, multifocaux ou commutables), le prototypage en salle blanche par photolithographie multiphotonique, ainsi que la caractérisation expérimentale des métasurfaces. Vous participerez également au développement d’outils logiciels dédiés et à la valorisation scientifique des résultats (publications, conférences). Consultez la fiche de poste détaillée ✔️ Vous avez des compétences en modélisation de métasurfaces, simulation optique (Lumerical/Planopsim, Zemax) et idéalement en photolithographie. ✔️ Vous avez de l’expérience en conception optique et/ou fabrication en salle blanche, avec des connaissances souhaitables en optique et perception visuelles. ✔️ Vous faites preuve d’autonomie, de curiosité et d’initiative pour faire avancer le projet, et vous appréciez le travail en équipe 🎓 Le profil recherché devra être titulaire d'un Doctorat (obtenu moins de 3 ans avant la date d’embauche) en optique, photonique, physique ou domaine équivalent. jobs.title: Onboarding Specialist - Fréjus
jobs.description: Salonkee est l'une des entreprises beauty-tech à la croissance la plus rapide en Europe. Nous aidons des milliers de salons à simplifier leurs opérations quotidiennes et à offrir une expérience client hors du commun. Notre logiciel tout-en-un simplifie la prise de rendez-vous, les paiements et la gestion client, permettant ainsi aux professionnels de se concentrer sur l'essentiel : délivrer une prestation exceptionnelle. Nous sommes fiers de façonner l'avenir de l'industrie de la beauté grâce à l'innovation, la collaboration et une approche résolument humaine. L'opportunité En tant qu’Onboarding Specialist, vous jouerez un rôle clé dans l’accompagnement de nos clients afin de leur garantir une expérience fluide et positive. Votre sens du service, votre approche proactive et votre capacité à résoudre les problèmes seront essentiels pour assurer la satisfaction de nos clients et contribuer au succès global de l’entreprise. Tes missions Intégration et formation : tu intègres et formes nos clients à l’utilisation de notre solution à travers des sessions de formation de 2 à 3 heures. Conseil et expertise : tu conseilles et partages ton expertise produit afin d’aider les clients à tirer le meilleur parti de leur abonnement. Point de contact privilégié : tu es le premier interlocuteur pour toute question ou demande client. Expérience client : tu gères et suis tes clients avec un objectif clair : offrir un service exceptionnel. Ta mission est de dépasser leurs attentes et de créer de véritables moments de satisfaction "WOW". Ton profil Formation : tu détiens un diplôme de bachelier ou tu justifies d'une expérience équivalente. Expérience : tu as une première expérience réussie dans une fonction de gestion de comptes ou de relation client. Esprit d'analyse : tu relies de solides capacités d'analyse à une approche créative pour la résolution de problèmes. Excellent relationnel : tu sais instaurer une confiance immédiate et créer un lien fort avec des entrepreneurs indépendant

jobs.description: Our Global Structure Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team. Why Deliveroo (part of DoorDash) Deliveroo, part of the DoorDash group, is building the leading local commerce platform, connecting consumers, merchants, and couriers in real time. Paris is one of our most strategic and complex markets globally, with unmatched density, brand concentration, and competitive intensity. As we move towards our 2026 ambition , we are evolving our commercial organisation to match the scale and sophistication required to win in Paris. This includes increased seniority, clearer regional ownership, and stronger execution across Inner and Outer Paris. The Senior Client Partner – Paris Inner Ouest role is a newly strengthened position, designed to combine strategic partner leadership, regional ownership, and organisation building . The Role As a Senior Client Partner, you ll lead a team of Account Management Lead, Senior Account Manager and Account Manager and you will report to the Regional Director of Paris, part of the Commercial team. The position is based in Paris.  You are accountable for the growth and performance of strategic brand portfolios across one of Paris’ most critical zones. You will act as the senior commercial owner for your territory, ensuring alignment between Paris-wide strategy and local execution. Beyond partner management, this role plays a central part in aligning the organisation to business challenges and ambitions . Kantor Pelayanan Pajak Pratama biasanya melayani wajib pajak yang memiliki jenis usaha atau perorangan dengan volume transaksi yang lebih kecil dibandingkan dengan kantor pajak yang lebih besar seperti Kantor Pelayanan Pajak Besar. Mereka juga melakukan pemeriksaan pajak untuk memastikan kepatuhan wajib pajak terhadap aturan perpajakan. Kantor Pelayanan Pajak Pratama ini biasanya tersebar di berbagai wilayah di seluruh Indonesia untuk memudahkan wajib pajak dalam mengakses layanan perpajakan tanpa harus pergi ke kantor pajak yang lebih besar. jobs.title: Rekrutmen Kedutaan Besar Amerika Serikat di Indonesia
jobs.description: Kedutaan Besar Amerika Serikat salah satu perwakilan negara dari Amerika Serikat di Indonesia untuk menjaga hubungan diplomatik saat ini sedang membuka lowongan kerja. Kedutaan Besar Amerika Serikat untuk Republik Indonesia terletak di Jakarta tepat di sebelah selatan Monas di Jalan Medan Merdeka Selatan. Bangunan aslinya dirancang oleh arsitek Ceko Antonin Raymond dan Ladislav Rado. Berikut ini adalah Lowongan Kerja Kedutaan Besar Amerika Serikat (AS) di Indonesia. Perwakilan diplomatik, misi diplomatik atau kedutaan adalah sekelompok orang dari suatu negara atau organisasi (sebagai negara/organisasi pengirim) yang hadir di negara lain (sebagai negara penerima) untuk mewakili secara resmi negara atau organisasi pengirim di negara penerima. Secara singkat, perwakilan diplomatik adalah orang-orang yang ditunjuk untuk melakukan hubungan diplomatik dengan negara lain. Kedutaan besar adalah perwakilan diplomatik yang umumnya berlokasi di ibu kota negara lain, yang menawarkan berbagai layanan diplomatik, termasuk layanan konsuler. Lowongan Kerja Kedutaan Besar Amerika Serikat di Indonesia Saat ini Kedutaan Besar Amerika Serikat di Indonesia memberikan kesempatan lowongan kerja untuk dapat bergabung bersama dengan posisi sebagai berikut: 1. HVAC Mechanic Salary: IDR Rp127.637.936 /Per Year Pemegang jabatan bertanggung jawab langsung kepada Supervisor Teknisi Mesin (Mechanical Engineer Supervisor). Pemegang jabatan dipekerjakan sebagai Teknisi HVAC (Heating, Ventilation, and Air Conditioning) untuk melaksanakan pekerjaan pemeliharaan dan perbaikan terampil pada tingkat teknisi HVAC ahli (journeyman), sesuai dengan standar International Building Code (IBC), di seluruh fasilitas yang berada di New Consulate Compound (NCC), termasuk gedung perkantoran, bangunan tambahan, struktur pendukung, serta properti tempat tinggal yang dimiliki maupun disewa.. Requirements: Semua kandidat yang terpilih harus dapat memperoleh dan memiliki Public Trust Pemeriksaan latar belakang keamanan.
